newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ governor sees no further fall in yen - Nikkei.
newsitem.headline: BOJ governor sees no further fall in yen - Nikkei.

text.p: Bank of Japan Governor Yasuo Matsushita sees no further, immediate fall in the yen's value, Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun (Nikkei) on Friday quoted the central bank head as saying.

"The recent level of the yen exchange rate has been stable, and it does not appear to be moving towards a further depreciation of the yen immediately, so import prices are likely to stabilise at current levels," Matsushita told Nikkei in an interview.
A fall in the yen against major currencies pushes up Japan's import bills.
